en.headline: Sundays By the Bay launches today at Pui O for Treasure Island's 30th
en.dek: The free monthly gathering at Treasure Island Campsite runs from noon to 6pm with live music, local makers and activities open to families and dogs.
body: The organisers of Treasure Island Beach Club said a new series called Sundays By the Bay would begin today at the campsite in Pui O on Lantau.
The free event marks the venue's 30th anniversary and is scheduled to run from 12pm to 6pm, with live music, DJs, food and drinks, local artisan stalls and community activities.

Families and dogs are welcome, and visitors may bring picnic blankets. The organisers said the series would continue on the second Sunday of each month through March 2027, with a special Eco Fest edition planned for November.

zh.headline: 貝澳Treasure Island海灣週日今首辦 慶祝30週年
zh.dek: 免費活動由中午12時至下午6時於貝澳營地舉行，設現場音樂、本地手作及社區活動，歡迎一家大小及寵物狗參與。
body: Treasure Island Beach Club主辦方表示，全新每月聚會「Sundays By the Bay」今日於大嶼山貝澳營地啟動。
活動免費入場，時間由中午12時至下午6時，現場有現場音樂、DJ、美食飲品、本地手作攤位及社區活動，慶祝場地成立30週年。
主辦方指活動歡迎家庭及狗狗參與，參加者可自備野餐墊。系列將於每月第二個星期日舉行至2027年3月，11月特別推出Eco Fest By the Bay。
